label: C-Pop / Electronic Rock with Cinematic influences

cards.mood: The piece opens with a somber, narrative-driven atmosphere that gradually accumulates tension through layered instrumentation.
cards.palette: A grand piano serves as the initial harmonic foundation, playing arpeggiated figures in the intro and verses.
